clients_subtitle: Browse the client list and open their price lists.
clients_table_hint: Select a client to open their price list.
name: Name
client_price_list_subtitle: Manage product prices for the selected client
price_list_help_title: How does the client price list work?
price_list_help_body: Enter a price and enable the switch to use an individual client price. When the switch is disabled, the product has no client-specific price and can use the default system price if available.
price_schedule_help_body: You can see the currently active price and scheduled future changes. Add a new entry from the modal. Existing records are not edited and future ones can be removed.
price_list_table_hint: Set a price for the product and decide whether it should apply to this client
client_order_subtitle: Add a client and place an order right away from the kitchen screen.
edit_client_order_subtitle: Change the order data and save your updates.
quick_add_client_hint: Enter the phone number and optional e-mail. The remaining fields will be saved as empty.
client_add_success: The client was added and selected for the order.
client_add_warning: The client was saved, but the ID could not be retrieved.
order_details_subtitle: Select a client, set the pickup time and add items.
order_edit_details_subtitle: Change the client, date, comment or order items.
product_select_hint: Selecting a product sets the VAT for calculations
price_modal_hint: Select a product, set the effective date and enter the net or gross price. The other value will be calculated automatically based on VAT.
missing_prices_body: Some products do not currently have an active price (no record with date <= today) or the price is 0. Fill them in to avoid pricing and production errors.
price_required: Enter a price greater than zero.
delete_only_future: Deletion is possible only for prices with a future date (today < Valid from).
valid_from_must_be_future: The Valid from date must be later than today (choose a future date).
